author: AshenOne109
quote: Waited 13 years and paid $70+ just to play a 30fps chore simulator. Critics giving this a 99 are out of their minds. The map looks pretty, sure, until you realize it’s just an empty set piece with clunky aiming, restricted weapon carry, and a story that forces you to do menial errands for your girlfriend between sluggish missions. You can’t even cause classic GTA chaos anymore without the hyper-aggressive police AI swarming you over minor speeding. It’s all graphical flex and zero actual fun. Biggest letdown in gaming history.
